Britain, Germany and France lead Europe's Nobel count by birthplace. The smaller countries on this map are the real story.

a thread 🧵🗺️
1/ On this map (source: nobelprize.org, by country of birth), the UK leads with 110 laureates, then Germany with 86 and France with 64. Sweden follows with 30, then Russia with 29 and Poland with 28.
2/ Italy and the Netherlands show 20 each, Austria and Switzerland 19 each. Switzerland has roughly 9 million people, Italy roughly 59 million, yet the totals are nearly the same.
3/ Hungary shows 12, ahead of Spain's 7, though Spain has about five times the population. Belgium shows 10, and Norway and Denmark show 13 each.
4/ Birth country is a tricky yardstick: borders moved, and many laureates worked in other countries from where they were born. Today's countries are used, not the states of the time.
5/ Which count on this map surprises you most? Tell us below. Follow @forummapping for more maps like this.
